anomaly_signals.detail: api-gateway has 2270 errors, forming the majority of the error rate.

recommended_action: Investigate the high error rate in api-gateway, auth-service, and payments-service. Check for cascading failures and LLM/tool issues.
summary: High error rate (14.16%) with significant contributions from api-gateway, auth-service, and payments-service. P99 latency is high at 11.89s. There are also notable LLM token truncations and tool failures.
